title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
Azure Data Engineer

Rate: To £500.00 Per Day - Inside IR35 via Umbrella

Location: 1-2 days per week in London (Candidates must be UK based and state their location)

Duration: Initial 3-month role with potential to extend

Our global consulting client requires a very Azure Data focused Engineer to design a data migration and data integration approach between a source system in an Azure SQL database and Salesforce.

To qualify for this role, we would expect the successful candidate to have strong skills in Azure SQL, Python, ETL, Salesforce REST APIs, batch data process (ie CSV files).

We are looking for someone who can start quickly with immediate availability or a short notice period. This would be an initial 3-month role with potential to extend, the contract will be in 3 month phases.

If your profile demonstrates strong and recent experience in the above areas - please submit your application to Jackie Dean at TXP for consideration. Please note applications must include your current location to be considered.
